title: The Cold War: US-Soviet Rivalry
text: The Cold War was a period of geopolitical tension between the United States and the Soviet Union and their respective allies from approximately 1947 to 1991. It was characterized by ideological competition between capitalism and communism, an arms race including nuclear weapons, proxy wars (Korea, Vietnam, Afghanistan), and the Space Race. Key events include the Berlin Blockade (1948), the Cuban Missile Crisis (1962), and the construction and fall of the Berlin Wall (1961, 1989). The Cold War ended with the dissolution of the Soviet Union on December 25, 1991. It shaped global politics, leading to the formation of NATO and the Warsaw Pact and influencing decolonization movements worldwide.
